messages:
carmen: Heads-up: planning a backfill+smoke for q4b-int4 today targeting promptbank gaps and golden anchors before canary.
devin: SGTM. Which gaps specifically? long-context, multi-turn, and code?
carmen: Yes. Also any prompts that historically flip between fp16 and earlier quant runs. Prioritize those.
rachel: I can run a stratified backfill job: 1) exact-token dedupe, 2) fuzzy cluster at 93% for near-duplicates, 3) sample 1.2k unique prompts with bias to multi-turn/code/anchors.
carmen: Keep near-duplicate audit CSV separate so we can inspect clustering mistakes.
devin: For quant profiles include q4b-int4-default and q4b-int4-compat (slightly different kernel fallback). Two rows per prompt for side-by-side review.
ops-bot: Scheduled job backfill-q4b-2026-03-23 started; output will be s3://redwood-qa/q4b-backfill/2026-03-23_batchA.csv
rachel: CSV header will include: sample_id,prompt_hash,intent,length_bucket,model_variant,quant_profile,decode_params,seed,baseline_model,batch_id,flag_reason
carmen: Add automated prefilter that computes token overlap vs franklin-fp16 baseline and an embedding-based semantic_change score. Flag if overlap_ratio < 0.66 OR semantic_change > 0.32.
devin: Pseudo-checker we can reuse:
```
overlap = tok_overlap(baseline, candidate)
sem = semantic_change(emb_baseline, emb_candidate)
if overlap / baseline_tokens < 0.66 or sem > 0.32:
  tag = "prefilter"
  flag_for_labeling(sample_id, tag)
```
labeler-ops-bot: @carmen created campaign q4b-int4-backfill-smoke (1400 tasks) -> group "smoke-reviewers"; priority=high; quick_review=true
rachel: Uploaded initial 700-unique prompts (1400 rows w/2 profiles) to s3://redwood-qa/q4b-backfill/initial_dual_profile.csv. Deduped=688, flagged_prefilter=108.
carmen: Label schema: severity=[none/minor/major/critical], regression_type=[hallucination,omission,formatting,code-safety,semantic-loss], notes. First 300 flagged -> senior-only.
devin: For code prompts include exec_risk boolean and static-lint auto-flag (eval/os.system/file-write patterns). Prioritize those for seniors.
labeler-ops-bot: Campaign q4b-int4-backfill-smoke updated: reviewers=senior(4)/rotating(6); tags_required=[severity,regression_type,exec_risk]; auto-tags=[prefilter,code_exec_flag]
rachel: Also snapshot baseline+candidate outputs for any flagged sample to s3://redwood-qa/q4b-backfill/flags/{sample_id}.json for repro.
carmen: Decision rules: pause rollout if instruction_accuracy_delta >5% OR any critical regression on a golden_anchor OR code exec_risk count multiplies >3x. Otherwise proceed phased canary.
devin: We'll log metrics per-batch: total_samples, flagged_count, severity_breakdown, per-intent_hotspots. Dashboard prefix q4b-backfill-2026-03-23-A.
carmen: Also include a small calibration probe: run the same filter on a held-out 200-anchor set to estimate false-positive rate before auto-routing. If anchor FPR > 2% we won't enable auto-blocking.
ops-bot: Job backfill-q4b-2026-03-23 completed upload: s3://redwood-qa/q4b-backfill/initial_dual_profile.csv (filesize=4.2MB)
rachel: First 150 labeled landed; senior-labeled-edgecases=45; next 150 routed. Current flagged_prefilter=108, code_exec_autoflags=7.
carmen: Great. I'll run the eval harness after the first 300 senior labels: produce a one-page with instruction_acc_delta, semantic_regression_rate, hallucination_count_delta, code_exec_flag_delta, and recommended action.
devin: If we see intent-specific regressions, we can try per-intent quant fallback or tweak decode_params. Keep a log of top 50 BLEU/semantic drop prompts for model-debugging.
carmen: Thanks team 44D keep updates terse in this thread and surface any ambiguous label examples to regression-triage.
